entities.name: Freya
entities.description: A woman whose life and tragedy unfold through an emotional collapse, involving a relationship with Gabriel, motherhood, abandonment, and the roots of Arthur's inherited revenge.
entities.quote: So if you want her story to hit properly, these are the key things that need time and explanation. 1) Who Freya is before Gabriel

entities.name: Gabriel
entities.description: A man whose moral collapse turns him from a loving partner into someone who throws Pristine and Freya away.
entities.quote: Gabriel should not be a flat “lover who later becomes cruel.” That would be too easy. His story needs proper emotional logic

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A force who enters Freya's orbit close to The Demon Before the Storm when the wound is already open, taking Pristine and later finding Freya.
entities.quote: Khalid’s direct involvement comes later, close to The Demon Before the Storm. That is actually good structure.

entities.name: Pristine
entities.description: Thrown away by Gabriel, later taken by Khalid, and subsequently becoming part of the Norman thread.
entities.quote: Since you locked: Gabriel throws Pristine away Khalid later takes Pristine and Pristine later becomes part of the Norman thread Then Pristine in Freya’s story is not just a side detail.

entities.name: Arthur
entities.description: Told a false history that Gabriel and Freya died by Duskmoor hands, motivating his revenge against Silas.
entities.quote: You locked that Arthur is later told: Gabriel and Freya died by Duskmoor hands and that becomes his revenge motive against Silas

entities.name: Silas
entities.description: Target of Arthur's revenge based on the false history of Gabriel and Freya's deaths.
entities.quote: that becomes his revenge motive against Silas So Arthur’s story depends on Freya’s story ending in a way that leaves behind narrative poison.

timeline_events.title: The Demon Before the Storm
timeline_events.description: The time period close to which Khalid directly enters Freya's orbit after her life is already collapsing.
timeline_events.quote: Khalid’s direct involvement comes later, close to The Demon Before the Storm. That is actually good structure.
